description.id: Orang sakit yang puasa membahayakan atau memperberat sakit boleh tidak berpuasa dan menggantinya ketika mampu.
description.en: A temporarily ill person for whom fasting is harmful or aggravating may defer and make up the days when able.

description.id: Musafir yang memenuhi kriteria boleh tidak berpuasa dan mengqada; batas perjalanan mengikuti fikih dan panduan lokal.
description.en: A qualifying traveller may defer fasting and make it up; travel criteria follow jurisprudence and local guidance.

description.id: Puasa tidak dilakukan selama haid atau nifas dan hari Ramadan yang terlewat diqada.
description.en: Fasting is not observed during menstruation or postpartum bleeding, and missed Ramadan days are made up.

sources: Consult a competent local religious authority for detailed rulings

description.id: Keringanan berlaku bila ada kekhawatiran bahaya. Kewajiban qada dan/atau fidyah berbeda menurut keadaan dan mazhab.
description.en: A concession applies where harm is reasonably feared. Make-up and/or fidyah duties differ by circumstance and school.

sources: Consult a competent local religious authority for school-specific rulings

description.id: Orang yang secara berkelanjutan tidak mampu berpuasa dapat memperoleh keringanan; fidyah dan ukurannya mengikuti penilaian medis serta otoritas lokal.
description.en: A person continuously unable to fast may receive a concession; fidyah and its amount follow medical assessment and local authority guidance.

description.id: Lansia yang tidak mampu berpuasa dapat memperoleh keringanan; bentuk penggantinya mengikuti ketentuan otoritas lokal.
description.en: A frail elderly person unable to fast may receive a concession; the required substitute follows local authority guidance.

description.id: Keadaan darurat yang mengancam keselamatan dapat membolehkan berbuka sebatas kebutuhan; kewajiban setelahnya dinilai sesuai kasus.
description.en: A safety-threatening emergency may permit breaking the fast to the extent needed; subsequent duties are assessed case by case.
